description: Welding introduces joining metal with heat: welding hazards and first aid, protective equipment and safety data sheets, cutting methods, welding processes and setup, practice beads and joints, and caring for equipment.

safety.note: Welding is taught only by a qualified person, with eye, hearing, hand and foot protection in use at all times.

outlineNote: The excerpts cut off partway through the list, so no requirement outline is published yet. Topics include hazards and first aid, safety data sheets and protective gear, cutting methods, comparing welding processes, setting up equipment, practice welds and joints, and equipment care.
